Application Summary

Overview

Red Oak Ridge Energy Center LLC (Applicant), a wholly owned subsidiary of Invenergy Clean Power LLC is seeking approval to construct a natural gas-fired simple-cycle combustion turbine-based large electric generating facility that will generate up to 1,186 megawatts (MW) in the Town of Paris, Kenosha County. Major components of the project include five, 242 MW gas turbines.
